lines.t: I don't look into the dark, I don't need a crystal ball
If I had a million dollars, Lord, I'd give it all
I was searching for a vision, looking everywhere
Now I’m standing at the Cross and I leave my burdens there
What I really wanna know, sweet Savior
What I really wanna say is I am saved
His grace is all I need, oh
My soul is gonna praise Him all my days
Walking in the light, leaving all my past behind
Peace is gonna find me every time
Felt the love, felt the light break through the dark
Now the Lord has given me a brand new heart
What I really wanna know, sweet Savior
What I really wanna say is I am saved
His grace is all I need, oh
My soul is gonna praise Him all my days
Yeah, I’m walking in the light
Lord, I’m walking in the light
